correctness.rationale: Independent polynomial multiplication and reduction modulo 0x11d verified the period 255 of alpha, evaluated all trace constraints, and found 51 points, with norm exponents 0,6,13 modulo 15. The explicit trace generator is injective and its binary Gram matrix vanishes. Independent hyperplane/coset generation of all 417,198 positive-dimensional subspaces and support calculation by word-weight sums reproduced each bin, the hierarchy (20,30,38,42,46,48,50,51), and the minimizer counts (34,34,323,17,510,85,51,1). The revised self-orthogonality proof using weight divisibility by four is valid.
residual_risks: The example number in the primary work could not be verified. The repaired finding is for one fully specified code and does not depend on this label.

evidence: The rank-collapse result identifies the general norm-fiber preimage and its size, and explicitly does not classify rank-two cases. In this case its size formula gives (2^(4−2)−1)(2^4+1)=51, not the higher support counts. The primary article was not available for a passage comparison.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Credit the norm description and length implication; the verified distinct finding concerns how all subspaces meet the rank-two locator set.

evidence: The locator set is the union of three norm-one cosets of size 17, but the norm exponents {0,6,13} are not a translate of {0,5,10}, so it is not the direct GF(4)* coset preimage. An irreducible cyclic length-51 model with root order 17 would have weights divisible by 3; root order 51 would have nonzero shift-orbits of size 51, in conflict with multiplicities 34 and 17.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The known norm-fiber reduction is applicable, but it does not identify the code with the usual irreducible cyclic alternatives or classify the rank-two case. The test does not exclude all possible code equivalences.

value.rationale: The two-coefficient Gold construction supplies a natural rank-two case distinct from the collapsed rank-one examples. The exact table gives extremal frequencies and all possible intermediate unions, e.g. 17 four-spaces at support 42 out of 200,787. It is a reproducible reference for how this small self-orthogonal code behaves beyond ordinary weights, without implying a rank-two family theorem.
residual_risks: No claim about all norm planes, equivalence classes, or subcode orbits.
